programs.title: Vida the Vet
programs.desc: Everyone is Sweetwood has an itchy nose or itchy eyes or sniffles, but they're not sick! Vida knows something in Sweetwood is the cause and finally figures it out -- flowers!

programs.title: Hey Duggee
programs.desc: The Squirrels are out tobogganing with Duggee when they spot a migrating bird fall from the sky. Mawk, the bird, lands in the snow, suitcase and all.

programs.title: Peppa Pig
programs.desc: Peppa and her friends are at playgroup. Today Madame Gazelle and all the children will be drawing pictures of their families.

programs.title: Bluey
programs.desc: Grandad is supposed to be resting, but when Bluey and Bingo go to visit him, he makes a run for it with the kids and takes them on a madcap adventure into the bush.

programs.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
programs.desc: Gingers tells the Pea-Rexes that she has a delicious treat for them - a hearty breakfast of yummy drops  except there is a twist. Ginger has hidden the drops and they have to go on a treasure hunt to find them!

programs.title: Kangaroo Beach
programs.desc: Lighthouse Storm: The cadets are learning how to scuba dive, including the all-important message: Always swim with a buddy. But Frizzy is distracted by her own obsessive mission.
